description: Current pay in the space industry for each kind of work, as a year's pay (an hourly posting counts at 2,080 hours), taken from the pay posted on open roles: the median, the middle half (25th to 75th percentile), and the number of posted figures and employers behind each. A figure appears only where three or more employers post pay.
name: get_space_jobs_pay
title: What space industry work pays
